course.title: The Agentic Bio Fellowship: Local Literature Synthesis and Grant Architecture
course.description: Privacy-first local synthesis of teaching abstracts into a BioE3-style outline. Agents plan; Nextflow executes. No cloud writer. 6–8 weeks. Individual ₹1.5L · Team ₹5L.

metadata.description:
A 6–8 week live Fellowship for PIs and senior scientists at ICMR, CSIR, and DBT labs. Same technical core as cohort 1. Skin: literature synthesis and grant architecture on a machine you control. Teaching abstracts are invented; we do not copy publisher PDFs.

The Fellowship does not file grants. Not a medical device.
metadata.requirements:
• Already writes grants or literature notes
  • Docker on a machine you control (or documented blocker + offline stub)
  • No requirement to upload unpublished manuscripts to a cloud writer
metadata.goals:
1. Run a local LLM with an explicit unpublished-text boundary
  2. Ship a Dockerized Python + R image
  3. Treat Nextflow as the execution plane
  4. Fill a BioE3-style outline from synthetic local abstracts
  5. Stop an outline loop at a human gate before any portal paste
  6. Deliver one autonomous local pipeline on the synthetic set

The failure mode

Unpublished text, reviewer comments, and institute reports are not public. A research copilot that ships them off-box is a leak. Grant structure is the product; the agency portal stays a human submit.

The Fellowship does not file grants. Teaching abstracts are invented; we do not copy publisher PDFs.

Pin the image

Synthesis still needs a pinned runtime. The image is how a co-PI reproduces the outline job without your laptop Python.

What to run

Lab folder: labs/02-container-r-python.

docker build -t agenticbio-lab02:local .
docker run --rm -v "$PWD/data:/data" -v "$PWD/outputs:/outputs" agenticbio-lab02:local python /opt/lab/summarize.py
docker run --rm -v "$PWD/data:/data" -v "$PWD/outputs:/outputs" agenticbio-lab02:local Rscript /opt/lab/summarize.R

Acceptance

  • Image builds on your machine (amd64 or arm64)
  • outputs/python_summary.txt and outputs/r_summary.txt exist
  • Host python3 / R are not required to produce those files
  • The Dockerfile pins a digest or a major tag you could defend in an audit

Audit trail

The workflow file records which abstract files were read. Chat is not a submission record. If a funding desk asks which notes fed a section, the answer is a path plus a Nextflow report.

What to run

Lab folder: labs/03-nextflow-execution-plane.

Or:

docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work -w /work nextflow/nextflow:24.10.0 nextflow run main.nf

Acceptance

  • results/summary.txt exists after a clean run
  • main.nf has at least two processes wired by a channel
  • You can explain the audit-trail rule in two sentences

Fail, patch, re-run

The agent proposes a fix. A human approves. The container re-runs. Max three iterations, then stop. Do not invent a cloud notebook.

This week’s fixture

Use the broken copy, not the canonical teaching file. Lab: 04-grant-synth-local-agent.

python3 synthesize.py --abstracts data/broken-abstracts --template data/bioe3-outline.md --out outputs/grant-outline-broken.md

Expected: the run fails or the output is obviously wrong because data/broken-abstracts/broken-abs.md is malformed on purpose. Write a patched copy under outputs/. Do not rewrite the canonical fixture in data/ without an explicit human yes.

What “self-correcting” is not

Unbounded retries against a production work dir. A bounded loop with a human signature on each patch that changes analysis code or inputs.

What belongs in the image

Interpreters, pinned libraries, the join/parse/retrieve script if it is part of the runtime. Anything a second fellow would need without your $HOME.

What is bind-mounted

Teaching abstracts and the outline template. Do not bake unpublished manuscripts into the image.

Network

Image build may use a package mirror. Analysis scripts must not call the network. No cloud writer. No paste of unpublished text to a public model API.

Minimal DSL2

Two processes wired by a channel: count lines, then write a summary. Use -c nextflow.config so the container image is explicit. If the agent cannot see which image tag ran, you do not have an audit trail.

Channels are the contract between processes. Do not reach into another process’s work directory from a side script. That is how “helpful” agents destroy -resume.

What to run

Lab folder: labs/03-nextflow-execution-plane.

nextflow run main.nf -c nextflow.config

Or:

docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work -w /work nextflow/nextflow:24.10.0 nextflow run main.nf

  • main.nf has at least two processes wired by a channel

Map tools, deny network

On OpenClaw or an equivalent local runtime, map tools to:

  • list_dir
  • read_file
  • run_nextflow
  • run_container

Deny network except optional package mirrors you already trust. Do not give the agent a general bash tool that can paste into an agency portal.

Implementation

Paste a short architecture note into the week-4 assignment: tools allowed, tools denied, and where the human gate sits. The gate sits before any portal paste.

  • An agency portal submit
  • A paste of unpublished manuscript text to a cloud writer
  • Invented budget lines or reviewer names
